legacy_addon_id.description: ID of the XenForo 1 add-on that this add-on replaces

title.description: Add-on title shown in the admin control panel

description.description: Description shown in the admin control panel

version_id.description: aabbccde: major, minor, patch, state (1 alpha, 3 beta, 5 release candidate, 7 stable, 9 patch level) and state version, for example 1020370 for 1.2.3. Must grow with every release.

version_string.description: Version shown to users, for example 1.2.3 or 1.2.3 Beta 1

extra_urls.description: Extra links: the key is the link text, the value is the URL

require.description: Requirements: XF, php, php-ext/<extension> or another add-on ID mapped to [version, "text shown when it is missing"]

items.description: Version ID for XenForo and add-ons, version string for PHP and extensions, or * for any version
Text shown when the requirement is not met

icon.description: Font Awesome icon name such as fa-home, or a path to an image in the add-on

composer_autoload.description: Path from the add-on root to the Composer vendor folder with autoload_psr4.php
